jurisdiction.venue: European Public Prosecutor’s Office (EPPO), Iași, Romania

docket_number: EPPO Iași Judicial Supervision & Seizure Action (Nov. 27, 2026)
headline: E.P.P.O. Raids Romania and Belgium Over ‘Smart Buildings’ IoT Grant Billed With 19 Phantom Employees
deck: Prosecutors in Iași placed three suspects under judicial supervision and froze nine properties worth €1 million after alleging a €1.1 million E.U.-funded project invoiced salaries for nonexistent staff and unpurchased know-how.

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: EPPO Iași and Belgian Federal Police carried out 14 searches across Romania and Belgium, placing three suspects under judicial supervision and seizing €1 million in real estate over alleged fictitious salaries for 19 non-working employees and fake know-how purchases on a €1.1 million EU-co-funded IoT smart-buildings grant.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Winning a public tech grant, padding the payroll ledger with 19 people who never showed up to work, and wiring the grant money through two foreign countries back into your personal pocket
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Multi-year prison terms for EU-fund subsidy fraud, forgery, and money laundering under Romanian law if proven at trial; all suspects remain presumed innocent

sources.title: EPPO carries out searches in Romania and Belgium in investigation into €1.1 million fraud involving smart buildings

interactive_art_spec.caption: The Palace of Culture in Iași, Romania. E.P.P.O. prosecutors in Iași seized five plots of land, two houses, and two apartments across the county in a cross-border probe into an alleged €1.1 million smart-buildings IoT grant scheme.
